name: stock-signal-platform
description: Technical analysis platform: indicators, explainable signals and backtesting over a PostgreSQL price cache.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
